note: Kernel law pack derived from enforced modules in 20.1. Replaces missing original prospectus registry.

rules.title: Chat is not authorization
rules.requirement: Conversation must never grant write, install, or apply permission.

rules.title: Narration is not completion
rules.requirement: Progress narration must not claim completion without evidence-derived status.

rules.title: No unsafe model claims
rules.requirement: Model output must not claim files were changed unless apply evidence exists.

rules.title: Bootstrap single use
rules.requirement: Bootstrap token is single-use and time-limited.

rules.title: CSRF on mutations
rules.requirement: Mutating API calls require matching CSRF token.

rules.title: Idempotency keys
rules.requirement: Mutating API calls require a unique Idempotency-Key.

rules.title: Origin boundary
rules.requirement: Requests must pass host/origin validation.

rules.title: One active mutating WO
rules.requirement: At most one draft/authorized/executing mutating work order per project.

rules.title: Authorize before apply
rules.requirement: Apply requires status authorized and sealed envelope.

rules.title: Envelope immutability
rules.requirement: Scope/budget/objective changes invalidate envelope hash.

rules.title: Survey required for draft
rules.requirement: from-survey drafts require verified survey evidence.

rules.title: Completion is derived
rules.requirement: Completion is computed from acceptance checks, never declared by chat.

rules.title: Path jail
rules.requirement: All file reads/writes resolve under project root without escape.

rules.title: Forbidden segments
rules.requirement: Writes under node_modules, .git, .jc are rejected.

rules.title: Transactional apply
rules.requirement: Partial apply rolls back to pre-write snapshot.

rules.title: Snapshot before write
rules.requirement: Scoped files are snapshotted before mutation.

rules.title: Export containment
rules.requirement: Export artifacts remain under .jc/exports.

rules.title: Capability gate
rules.requirement: Repair/build apply requires SOURCE_REPAIR_CAPABILITY.enabled.

rules.title: Scope exactPaths
rules.requirement: Only authorized exactPaths may be written.

rules.title: Budget ceilings
rules.requirement: File and line budgets are enforced at apply.

rules.title: Structured parse fail-closed
rules.requirement: Malformed plan/edit output aborts after at most one re-prompt.

rules.title: Temperature clamp
rules.requirement: Structured generation temperature is forced ≤ 0.2.

rules.title: Jailed verification
rules.requirement: npm scripts run shell:false with sanitized env and timeout.

rules.title: Integrity fallback
rules.requirement: When scripts cannot run, file-integrity may be used and must be labeled.

rules.title: Failed verify rolls back
rules.requirement: Failed verification triggers snapshot rollback.

rules.title: Install requires scope op
rules.requirement: npm install runs only when install_dependencies is authorized.

rules.title: Ignore scripts
rules.requirement: Install always uses --ignore-scripts.

rules.title: Install cwd jail
rules.requirement: Install cwd is project root only.

rules.title: Build near-empty only
rules.requirement: Build intent requires empty or near-empty folder.

rules.title: Repair for existing code
rules.requirement: Existing codebases use repair intent, not build.

rules.title: Evidence hash verify
rules.requirement: Evidence envelopes are content-hash verified on read.

rules.title: Apply evidence recorded
rules.requirement: Successful and failed applies record evidence including verification.

rules.title: Survey samples read-only
rules.requirement: Content samples are bounded and never write paths.

rules.title: Local first
rules.requirement: Ollama is preferred; cloud requires budget.

rules.title: Mock labeled
rules.requirement: JC_MOCK_MODEL must be explicit and reported in health.

rules.title: Capability-gated controls
rules.requirement: Repair/build controls disabled when capability is off.

rules.title: Inactive stages labeled
rules.requirement: Unavailable stages must not appear as executable.

rules.title: Kernel invariant 1
rules.requirement: Preserve fail-closed defaults for invariant 1; no silent privilege expansion.
